Pipeline.description: POST assigns a fresh id and derives host/method/path from endpoint_id. Feature order is significant. Versions are immutable.

DatasetImport.description: Maximum request size 16 MiB; up to 100,000 rows. JSONL event rows or CSV with exact named columns. At least 20 complete vectors for import.

RecordingManifest.title: PragmaChange recording manifest v1
RecordingManifest.description: Import requires finalized=true, at least one row, exact byte/row counts and SHA-256 of UTF-8 records.jsonl including its final newline. Top-level pipeline bindings must equal config bindings. Records are at most 16 KiB each. Field string limits are UTF-8 byte limits.
